name: Voyage Slider
description: Full-screen 3D tilt image slider showing a center slide flanked by blurred neighbors, with a blurred backdrop, staggered title text, arrow controls and a percentage loader.
contents: Slides with image, title, subtitle and description
Blurred full-bleed backdrop of the current image
Loading overlay with percentage and label
behavior: Current slide scales up while previous and next tilt and fade to the sides
Mouse movement over a slide tilts it in 3D with eased interpolation and shifts the image
Text lines slide up in sequence when a slide becomes current
Loader counts up as images finish loading, then fades out
Slider wraps around at both ends
editableByProps: Slide size, aspect ratio and transition speed
Background and text colors, loader and button labels

needsCodeEdit.change: Change side slide offset, rotation or blur

needsCodeEdit.where: bg- backdrop layer map with before: classes

fixed: Backdrop layers and the loading overlay use fixed positioning over the whole viewport
Root fills the viewport height; override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto
Runs its own requestAnimationFrame loop, cleaned up on unmount
Tilt effect responds to mouse only; touch devices use the arrows
